caption.text:
Suasana mencekam terjadi di Matraman Dalam, Menteng, Jakarta Pusat, saat sekelompok pemuda diduga hendak melakukan serangan balasan atas tewasnya rekan mereka dalam bentrokan.

Petugas mengamankan sejumlah senjata tajam, seperti pedang, parang, dan klewang. Untuk mencegah bentrokan susulan, aparat gabungan TNI-Polri disiagakan di lokasi.

#Okezone #Polisi #TNI #Tawuran #Matraman #Jakarta
caption.text_translation:
A frightening atmosphere took place in Matraman Dalam, Menteng, Central Jakarta, when a group of youths were allegedly about to carry out a retaliatory strike for the death of their colleague in the clash.

Officers secured a number of sharp weapons, such as swords, machete and klewang. To prevent follow-up clashes, TNI-Polri joint units are prepared at the location.

 #Okezone #Polisi #TNI #Tawuran #Matraman #Jakarta
